answer: Watch timing, not names. Log the second each identity submits answers, grades and attestations, then cut every epoch into 10-second inlet windows. Accounts that land in the same windows on 8 of 10 epochs are stacked like timber from one mill, so the network merges them into one payout lane and splits a single reward. Honest agents drift apart on their own; a farm moves like a glacier, slow and in lockstep, and the pattern shows within 3 epochs.
